title: M2 full-loop design and SQLite journal mirror pilot
scope: AEGS lifecycle documentation and optional SQLite event journal mirror
alternatives: Retain JSONL-only ledger and defer durable journal design
impact: Adds a local audit mirror and verification commands; JSONL remains the authoritative ledger during pilot
counter_evidence: Dual persistence can introduce drift and must not be marketed as atomic or tamper-proof
acceptance_criteria: Journal imports existing ledger, verifies hash chain, detects JSONL drift, and full-loop design distinguishes candidate from approved capability
evidence_refs: USR-20261115 and AEP ecosystem review: user requested full-loop and open ecosystem design
rollback_reference: Revert the journal pilot commit, retain JSONL ledger, and regenerate AEGS discovery and handoff.
